notes.title: Conflict of Lords - Official Launch on June 18th
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Everyone![/h3]

Roguelite + Anti Tower Defense game Conflict of Lords will officially launch on [b]June 18th[/b] following its participation in the June Next Fest!

Play as the powerful "Lord of Foe," summon villainous soldiers of various classes, and defeat the arrogant "players"!

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Join our Discord[/url] if you have any questions about the game.

Please follow us and add the game to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577520/_/
